rules: Normal edit: only the hook changes (sometimes the rehook). Body, end clip, caption style and song placement come from the template.

Hook longer or shorter than the template: the tool ripples the timeline. Body and CTA move, the hook caption stretches, the song starts earlier (music box, handoff fixed) or runs longer (no end sound).
Store-claim hooks (RUN to <STORE>, <BRAND> x <STORE>, '<STORE> just collabed') pair with the reveal CTA (JK / Just JOKING / Je rigole). Every other hook pairs with the plain CTA.
Use the store the hook clip actually shows (TARGET / WALMART / COSTCO / LECLERC / CARREFOUR).
